'''Huntington Beach Mega Tournament II''' was a two-day Star Wars CCG event in Huntington Beach, California. Day 1 was eight-game constructed. The first-place prize was six uncut Limited Premiere sheets. Day 2 was a team event. The Information Broker ([[Tim Guzman]]) published a Day 1 report on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="mega">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Megatournament2.htm Mega Tournament II in Huntington Beach California], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234227/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Megatournament2.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
